title: Pytest on a machine without relay still creates and…
what: tests/conftest.py:40: MEDIUM: F3 pytest on a machine without relay still creates and leaves $HOME/.relay/test-tokens (the same VPS failure, other runner)
why: Found by the review of the test-token fix (30 Oct): the fix covers tests/run_unittest.py, but pytest on a machine without relay still creates and leaves $HOME/.relay/test-tokens, the same leak seen on the VPS ai.amidman.com. Its twin finding F4 (relay_ledger binds ledger_dir at import) is item a-test-leaves-relay-ledger-bound-to-a-patched-le.
failing_case: HOME=<empty scratch folder>, RELAY_HOME and RELAY_TEST_TOKENS unset:
`pytest -q tests/test_relay_tokens.py -k 'test_defaults or RunnerPool'` -> 5 passed, and afterwards
<HOME>/.relay/test-tokens/token-8 and <HOME>/.relay/test-tokens/waiting exist. Expected: HOME left empty.
pass_cases: 1. Empty HOME, RELAY_HOME unset: after a pytest run HOME is empty.
2. Under relay gate (RELAY_TEST_TOKENS passed), the pytest session still uses the gate's pool and takes no token.
3. On a machine whose pool exists, a pytest session still takes one SHARED token of it.
